At the same time, Fathir unexpectedly runs into his ex-girlfriend, Clara, whose presence changes everything.

programme.title: Di Depan Dukung, Di Belakang Nikung
programme.desc: Riska (Rina Diana), who has run away from home, is hit by a minibus driver named Arya (Vicky Nitinegoro). Upon arriving at Arya's house, Riska looks for an excuse to stay there.

programme.title: 饭戏攻心2
Table for Six 2
programme.desc: 这是饭戏攻心的续集，讲述二哥和三哥在大哥离家之际，计划要结婚最后，他们的婚宴成为一个混乱的战场，婚宴升级为家族斗兽场，造成一场喜上加喜的饭戏！

programme.title: Leio / Leio
programme.desc: 一名过气歌手回乡奔丧并顺道参加一场钻井大赛，除了拯救家乡干旱的土地，更希望赢得百万现金大奖但他和其他参赛者都不知道，在这片干涸的土地下，竟潜藏着凶猛无比的致命巨兽，准备将人类生吞活剥！

programme.title: 曾经拥有
Remember What I Forgot
programme.desc: 港产片影痴吴少金患有阿兹海默症，依靠弟弟撑起两人合办的电器维修店节目监制细姜对吴少金的古灵精怪行为感到好奇，怀疑他可能是个以尖酸刻薄的影评谋利的影评人于是，细姜假扮朋友接近吴少金和他的家人，却渐渐发现他的秘密和辛酸故事

programme.title: 恶战
Once Upon a Time in Shanghai
programme.desc: 二十世纪初，各地劳动人口纷纷涌入高速发展之上海山东青年马永贞(伍允龙 饰)亦到上海当码头工人当时上海各帮派荼毒社会，其中较有正义感之龙七(安志杰 饰) 赏识马永贞胆识过人武技非凡二人惺惺相惜，成为好友龙七反对贩毒及向日军卖力，与斧头帮三大犯罪头子白癞痢(陈观泰 饰)笑面佛(袁祥仁 饰)仇老四(冯克安 饰)为敌，马永贞与他连手反毒，令三人怀恨于心马永贞与江湖卖艺的铁师父(洪金宝 饰)及其两个女儿铁梅(蒋璐霞 饰)铁菊(胡然 饰)成为邻居马永贞被铁菊的硬朗性格所吸引，而铁菊亦佩服马永贞的正义感，对他渐渐产生好感龙七则迷恋上歌女盛香君(毛俊杰 饰)，没想到日后竟因此而身陷险境斧头帮因不满龙七的嚣张跋扈，与日本间谍桥本密谋除掉他，龙七惨遭暗算马永贞的邻居亦遭受袭击，马永贞赶至时已尸横遍野，垂死的铁师傅告知铁菊被斧头帮掳走极度悲痛的马永贞为救铁菊，单人匹马闯入斧头帮老巢，决定用双手消灭国家的敌人社会的败类，为民除害!

programme.title: 捣破法兰克
Smashing Frank
programme.desc: 四名戴着兔子面具的年轻劫匪策划了针对上流社会的抢劫行动他们自称Frank，目的不是为了金钱，而是透过涂鸦和疯传影片揭露贪污的真相当他们与一个涉及洗黑钱的强大教会组织发生冲突时，行动迅速演变成一场致命的博弈

programme.title: 我老婆系赌圣
My Wife is a Gambling Maestro
programme.desc: 一次偶然的机会，阿轮在沙滩救了患上失忆症的盈盈，并招呼她回家中居住盈盈不单美丽性感，还身手了得，帮助阿轮收坏胀，把欺负他的女友打走盈盈心算比计算器还要快，且赌术精湛，麻雀赌波赛马，她无一不精通阿轮深深的爱上了盈盈，向她求婚，可惜在婚礼举行前夕，盈盈突然失踪当阿轮找到她时，原来她已在参加亚洲赌王大赛，对手是无恶不作的赌场大鳄仇曼联，她还有一个未婚夫亨利阿轮呆住了：难道这一趟他又好梦成空？

programme.title: 不是你不爱你
Love at First Lie
programme.desc: 那年暑假，性格开朗善良的平凡少女阿宝偶遇不务正业的富家子家伟为报复父亲再婚，家伟聘用阿宝及其好友等人捣乱婚礼，促成他与阿宝认识并开始交往两人情投意合，尝尽热恋甜蜜，岂料命运却为这段爱情安排了急转直下的暗涌

programme.title: 猎狐行动
Fox Hunt
programme.desc: 本片改编自真实案件诈骗犯戴逸宸骗取大量民众血汗钱后神秘失踪，七年潜逃海外后，终在法国巴黎现身中国侦缉探员叶钧率领猎狐小队跨国追赃，却在行动中揭开惊人秘密

programme.title: 死尸死时四十四
Over My Dead Body
programme.desc: 这部黑色喜剧始于一具来历不明的尸体被发现在一个住宅单位门前，同层的四家人担心尸体会令居所变成凶宅，使楼价大跌，从而卷入了将尸体运走的大混乱中

programme.title: 迷城
Wild City
programme.desc: 天民原本是一名警察，后来转行经营酒吧一天深夜，正当他准备关门时，遇见了一位醉酒女子，却因此招惹上她的前任情人及其手下的追杀随着天民的弟弟和一箱现金卷入其中，这场致命的追逐变得愈发危险

programme.title: 哥，你好
Give Me Five
programme.desc: 无所事事的小伍与患上脑退化症的爸爸相依为命，而爸爸只剩下和妻子有关的零碎记忆为替父亲寻回失去的回忆，小伍阴差阳错穿越时空回到过去，却意外破坏了父母的过去遭遇小伍要使父母二人复合，否则他不会出生在这世上

programme.title: 金手指
The Goldfinger
programme.desc: 电影取材自80年代香港最大宗的财经丑闻，讲述程一言由一个寂寂无名的小喽啰一跃而成为亿万富豪，并担任上市公司主席的故事然而，当程一言的财富疯狂飙升，势力日益壮大时，廉署高级调查主任刘启源决定介入调查，即使花了长达15年时间，也誓要找出真相

programme.title: 夺冠
Leap
programme.desc: 2008年北京奥运会，昔日中国女排传奇郎平竟以美国队主教练身份击败中国队，深陷舆论漩涡多年后，当中国女排陷入低谷之际，她毅然回归，执教新一代女排新力军她以铁腕改革打破常规，带领球员们绝地突围，最终在2016年里约奥运上演惊天逆袭，重夺奥运金牌

programme.title: 老狐狸

programme.desc: 1989年，年轻的廖杰和他的父亲为购房而存钱，却不知道房价正在飙升饱受贫困之苦，他向房东老狐狸学会在社会中求生存廖杰最终以所学伤害了老狐狸，但他的同情心终究使他没有成为另一个老狐狸

programme.title: 全城地图：最强明星队
The Best Team
programme.desc: 全城地图：最强明星队是一运动竞技实境节目，由钱薇娟与江宏杰分别领军蓝红两队，以城市为竞技场，穿梭全台进行团队对抗该节目以将城市化为竞技场为概念，集结好手争夺最强明星队荣耀The Best Team is a sports reality competition programme where Taiwan national athletes and celebrities take part in Blue and Red teams respectively, using cities as their battlegrounds, travelling across Taiwan and compete against one another. Based on the concept of turning cities into arenas, the programme brings together top athletes to vie for the title of the ultimate celebrity team.

programme.title: Tusker: Brotherhood of Elephants
programme.desc: Become immersed in the intricate lives of tuskers with Craig, Pascal, and Esau, three male African elephants in all stages of life. Get a rare glimpse into the subtle language, complex interactions, and deep bonds of the world's largest land mammal.

programme.title: Wild Tales from the Farm Season 1
programme.desc: Experience life on the farm as things heat up for summer. Watch animals swelter in a rare heatwave, try to stay cool in the nearby freshwater stream, and stash supplies for fall.

programme.title: Cub Camp Season 1
programme.desc: Get to know Winston, a tiny abandoned cub who imprints on Judy as she nurses him 24-7. Feel the heartbreak as she severs their emotional attachment and teaches this sweet little fellow how to be a grown-up, independent bear in the non-human world.

programme.title: Cub Camp Season 1
programme.desc: Welcome sisters Xiba, Xyla, and Xola, a trio of starving orphans who turn Winston's world upside down before gentle Xola teaches him a lesson about friendship. Then monitor new cubs Yasmine and Yara, who get reacquainted after a stressful separation.

programme.title: The Ocean's Greatest Feast
programme.desc: Get a front-row seat to the planet's biggest biomass migration, the annual 1,000-mile sardine run along South Africa's east coast. See billions of these tiny fish run a gauntlet of hungry predators, including stealthy seals and dive-bombing gannets.

programme.title: Africa's Wild Year Season 1
programme.desc: Autumn in Africa brings opportunities. Cape Fur seals, Samango monkeys, chameleons, impala, and more respond to the season. Autumn triggers changes in the lives of many animals. Rare creatures reveal themselves and predators gather to take advantage.

programme.title: Africa's Wild Year Season 1
programme.desc: Be an eyewitness to the death and resurrection that winter brings to Africa. Observe what comes with shorter days, from drought conditions to frigid winds, and marvel at the survival skills of animals and plants as they face the season's fury.

programme.title: Wild Dogs: Pack vs. Pride Season 2
programme.desc: Head back to the den with the Kakumbi, who are mourning the loss of two pups. Chance upon a hyena den and a lion pride trying to take down a buffalo, then catch up with the Manzi, who are in a standoff with a leopard and a herd of angry elephants.

programme.title: Arctic Secrets Season 2
programme.desc: The Hudson Bay lowlands are part of North America's largest wetland. Over 300,000 square kilometers of muskeg, a vast bogland as far as the eye can see characterized by water soaked peat, mosses and stunted trees. Once thought of as barren wasteland, it is now understood that these bogs are crucially important to life on earth. Globally, there is as much carbon dioxide held in wetlands as there is in the atmosphere.The peatland ecosystem is the most efficient carbon sink on the planet.

programme.title: Extreme Africa Season 1
programme.desc: South Africa's Drakensberg is one of the continent's most impressive landscapes. It is home to sharp climatic and ecological gradients as physical conditions change for both land-based creatures and the Raptors that swirl in the skies above.

programme.title: Extreme Africa Season 1
programme.desc: In north Tanzania, towering mountains line a dramatic valley. Enriched by ancient volcanoes, its slopes provide a variety of habitats for life to thrive and its great centerpiece holds water through even the driest of times.

programme.title: Extreme Africa Season 1
programme.desc: Simien Mountains National Park in Ethiopia is home to some of the rarest creatures on earth. Take a glimpse into life on some of the highest peaks in Africa, in the last stronghold of shaggy, grass-grazing Geladas, elusive Simien wolves and horned Walia ibex.

programme.title: Extreme Africa Season 1
programme.desc: The Southern Drylands is a journey into the most arid and extreme environments in the furthest reaches of southern Africa. We go to spectacular but treacherous places where almost no rain falls, to find incredibly resilient creatures and learn the secrets to their survival. From the largest mammals to the fastest insects and even a ghost-like fish found nowhere else in the world, the Southern Drylands contain some extraordinary inhabitants, all connected by the daily challenges of living in s...

programme.title: Extreme Africa Season 1

programme.title: Extreme Africa Season 1

programme.title: Becoming Elephant: the Orphans of Reteti Season 1

programme.title: Becoming Elephant: the Orphans of Reteti Season 1

programme.title: Superbeast Season 1

programme.title: CAHAYA CINTA AZZURA 6
programme.desc: Cahaya is a beautiful young woman who works at a fish farm owned by Adipura, a wealthy businessman in a village in Sukabumi. One day, Cahaya's father is involved in an accident and is hospitalized. Desperate to find money for his treatment, Cahaya turns to Adipura for help. Adipura agrees, but on one condition: Cahaya must marry him.

programme.title: SAYAP CINTA TERINDAH EPS 35
programme.desc: It tells the story of Dhani, the firm and responsible eldest son, as he strives to take care of his three younger siblings (David, Ariel, and Isyana) in order to fulfill their father Haris's dream of having a harmonious family. Dhani carries a heavy burden, but he faces serious challenges as his siblings resent him and each of them harbors their own complicated secrets.

programme.title: THEATER DRAMA : MY UJANG FROM KAMPUNG BERUNG
programme.desc: A program drama FTV about love, friendship, family, happy, sad etc, played by popular actor and actress Indonesia.

programme.title: CAHAYA TERINDAH EPS 68-69
programme.desc: A drama series that tells the story of Indah (Ranty Maria) and her struggle to find her biological family after discovering that she was adopted. She runs away to Jakarta from her adoptive father (Jamal), who intends to sell her, and ends up working for the Hendardi family, where she faces romantic conflicts and emotional mysteries from her past.

programme.title: TURUN RANJANG EPS 36
programme.desc: Albi (Samuel Zylgwyn) is forced to marry his sister-in-law, Naza (Rachquel Nesia), at the request of his father-in-law, Wira. This decision is made for the sake of caring for baby Zia (Faradilla Yoshi), Albi's wife, who falls into a coma after giving birth. This pressured marriage becomes difficult for both Albi and Naza, as they were previously in love with other people.

programme.title: TERIKAT JANJI EPS 36
programme.desc: A drama series that tells the story of Davina, a conglomerate's daughter who falls into poverty after being betrayed. She is forced to pretend to be in a relationship with Sena, a ketoprak street vendor. This fake relationship, meant to protect her reputation, becomes complicated when Sena is actually an undercover intelligence agent on a mission tied to his pastfurther intensified by conflicts involving a stepmother and past betrayals.

programme.title: CINTA BERAKHIR BAHAGIA 112
programme.desc: Adisty, a beautiful young woman who serves as the backbone of her family, nearly becomes a sex worker to pay off her family's debts. programme.title: 全城地图：最强明星队
The Best Team
programme.desc: 全城地图：最强明星队是一运动竞技实境节目，由钱薇娟与江宏杰分别领军蓝红两队，以城市为竞技场，穿梭全台进行团队对抗该节目以将城市化为竞技场为概念，集结好手争夺最强明星队荣耀The Best Team is a sports reality competition programme where Taiwan national athletes and celebrities take part in Blue and Red teams respectively, using cities as their battlegrounds, travelling across Taiwan and compete against one another. Based on the concept of turning cities into arenas, the programme brings together top athletes to vie for the title of the ultimate celebrity team.

programme.title: 型男大主厨
Stylish Man
programme.desc: 台湾广受欢迎的常青美食料理节目，由2006年始播至今，2011年还获选金钟奖的最佳综合节目主持人奖每一期将有不同的主题：大明星來下廚由兩位明星或两个明星档分組對抗，拿出自己的拿手菜對抗比拼；五分钟出好菜由两位厨师根据指定食材，在五分钟内烹煮出易学美味的一道菜等这是一个富有娱乐效果的轻松美食节目，能够持续制作这么多年不是没有理由的

programme.title: 勇敢无双龙秀晶
The Brave Yong Su Jeong
programme.desc: 该剧为一部浪漫复仇剧，讲述了梦想成为现代版巨商林尚玉的女子龙秀晶与将命运托付给她的吝啬鬼绝症患者吕义柱相遇后，两人共同展开复仇的故事剧中还涉及与财阀家族相关的出生秘密等人物关系Yong Su-Jeong is a popular but shy-in-love host who has a crush on a rich heir, Joo Woo-Jin, while hardworking Yeo Ui-Joos life changes when he discovers hes also part of the same wealthy family.

programme.title: 焦急的恋爱
My Military Valentine
programme.desc: 南北韩停战宣言后的未来，为实现南北统一而在DMZ建设的试点智慧城市和平市作为韩国顶流偶像的劳埃德在和平市结束庆祝汇演后，在进行罕见军械装备交易时，遇到当时执行炸弹搜索任务的朝鲜特种兵英玉，被她误认为是恐怖分子更糟糕的是，在那一瞬间有记者们还拍下了照片，劳埃德陷入了丑闻之中，对英玉的第一印象可谓强烈为了躲避丑闻而入伍的劳埃德，在部队与教官英玉再次见面某天，完成反恐训练从训练场返回生活馆的途中，劳埃德从行军队伍中掉队，迷路彷徨之时遇到被反统一极右派团体 紫罗兰 追赶的自己的超级粉丝韩松伊

programme.title: Superbeast Season 1
programme.desc: Bow down to one of nature's most ancient and deadly endurance predators. Watch tiger sharks exploit turtle nesting chaos, survive oxygen-poor environments with epaulette sharks, and withstand the crushing pressure of the deep with ghost sharks.

programme.title: Superbeast Season 1
programme.desc: Prowl the ocean with sharks of all kinds and see why these predatory fish reign supreme under the sea. Stalk coral labyrinths with reef sharks, lie in wait for the perfect strike with wobbegongs, and embark on epic migrations with great whites.

programme.title: Superbeast Season 1
programme.desc: Bask in the awe-inspiring strength of the animal kingdom's most powerful creatures. Smash through rock-hard termite mounds with silverback gorillas, see jaguars that can crush caiman skulls, then head to the ocean to witness orcas hunting in packs.

programme.title: Gladiators Season 1
programme.desc: Witness clashes over precious resources when the dry season brings a band of gladiators to an African savannah watering hole. See a lion-elephant territory brawl, an ant raid on a termite mound, and a honey badger's risky dance with a deadly snake.

programme.title: Gladiators Season 1
programme.desc: Go up against Australia's wiliest gladiators and their impressive arsenals. Learn if these weapons, such as the kangaroo's deadly boxing moves and the redback spider's precision-engineered traps, can help them survive the ravages of climate change.

programme.title: Carpathian Predators Season 1
programme.desc: Join a mother brown bear as she struggles to find food for her two young cubs while teaching them essential skills for the harsh winter ahead. Then visit a pair of tiny lynx kittens as they begin to venture away from the safety of their den.

programme.title: Animal Senses Season 1
programme.desc: The first sense to evolve in the first animals was chemoreception: being able to detect chemicals in the animal's environment. This helps animals find prey and mates, and to sense predators from a distance.

programme.title: Arctic Secrets Season 2
programme.desc: The Yukon is a true wilderness, one of the last on Earth. The vast land got its name from its longest river, which the Gwich'in, one of the indigenous people of the region, call "Yu-kun- ah", or, the "great river". The third longest waterway in North America, the Yukon River flows through wide open valleys and narrow channels over 3,000 km Northwest towards the storm tossed Bering Sea.

programme.title: America's Wild Border: Northern Exposure
programme.desc: Trail Atlantic puffins, Prairie rattlesnakes, Alaskan caribou and other animals as they travel across the international boundary between the U.S. and Canada. See how they can move from safety to target by crossing a line they had no say in creating.

programme.title: Gangs of Lemur Island Season 1
programme.desc: As the dry season approaches, tensions rise on Lemur Island, both between rival gangs and within their own ranks. Get a view from the battlefield as the female leaders fiercely defend their turf, while their newborn infants cling to them for safety.

programme.title: Gangs of Lemur Island Season 1
programme.desc: As food and water become scarce, Crystal, the fierce leader of the Ruins gang, sets her sights on rival Kati's territory and its neighboring fruit trees. Watch as Crystal's move and a raid by outside invaders lead to dire consequences for one troop.

programme.title: Gangs of Lemur Island Season 1
programme.desc: The drought is finally over, but traversing the forest for food is still a gamble. See some leaders take the risk, leaving home territories undefended to feast on a cicada boom. When they return, trespassers are ready for a fight.

programme.title: Gangs of Lemur Island Season 1
programme.desc: As the babies grow, new power struggles break out in each troop. Watch as every member, from fierce Queen Crystal to low-ranking Erica, jockeys for position. Meanwhile, the babies start to understand how allies and enemies will shape their future.

programme.title: Gangs of Lemur Island Season 1
programme.desc: The pressure to find food reaches new heights and throws the reserve into turmoil. Witness fractures emerge within the ranks, dividing the gangs and leading Crystal, the indomitable leader of the Ruins gang, to face a challenge like none before.

programme.title: Orangutan Jungle School Season 2
programme.desc: The race is on to find Tulia and Zalipa, who are missing from Palas Island. And after months of convalescence, Beni returns to forest school but faces another setback at the milk bucket. Meanwhile, the vets keep a close eye on pregnant Dilla.

programme.title: Orangutan Jungle School Season 2
programme.desc: The fate of several graduates awaits the next round of wild releases. Meanwhile, runaway Zalipa is found, but her partner in crime, Tulia, is still missing. And Baby Clarita has a complete meltdown as the vets perform surgery on her mother.

programme.title: Orangutan Jungle School Season 2
programme.desc: Trouble brews when the team makes the final attempt to reunite reluctant mother Dilla with her new baby Delilah. And Alba, the world's only known albino orangutan, amazes her friends with her unique approach to termite foraging.

programme.title: Wild Tales from the Farm Season 1
programme.desc: It's spring, and the farm is bursting with new life. Watch a ewe give birth to twins, an orphaned Hereford calf struggle to find a surrogate mother, and the top hen nestle down in her maternity coop.

programme.title: Wild Tales from the Farm Season 1
programme.desc: Experience life on the farm as things heat up for summer. Watch animals swelter in a rare heatwave, try to stay cool in the nearby freshwater stream, and stash supplies for fall.

programme.title: Ireland's Wild Islands Season 1
programme.desc: Endure winter and early spring on the west coast, where animals eke out a chilly existence. Watch red deer battle on windswept Inishvickillane, welcome seal pups amid howling storms on the Inishkea islands, and view the return of the basking sharks.

programme.title: Ireland's Wild Islands Season 1
programme.desc: Explore a 1,500-year-old monastery among the dizzying crags of the world-famous Skellig Islands. Spy Manx shearwaters and humpback whales, then chase after pygmy shrews on Clare before heading to the Aran Islands for a peek at an autumn spectacle.

programme.title: Bugs That Rule the World Season 1
programme.desc: Look at what a global insect decline could do to our planet. Uncover our historical dependence on these tiny animals, the vital roles they play in our ecosystems, and the reasons why our fragile relationship to them is in danger worldwide.

programme.title: Bugs That Rule the World Season 1
programme.desc: Learn how bees, butterflies, moths, and other pollinators keep our fields and forests fruitful, and weigh what life would be like if these busy bugs vanished. Witness a mysterious butterfly pilgrimage and a moth's clever way of escaping hungry bats.

programme.title: Bugs That Rule the World Season 1
programme.desc: Go up against predatory insects that are tailor-made for killing. See why the terrifying praying mantis has the agility of a martial artist and an appetite for everything from flies to hummingbirds, then go hunting in mid-air with deadly dragonflies.

programme.title: Bugs That Rule the World Season 1
programme.desc: Get a sanitation lesson from nature's original cleanup crew. Learn how beetles keep ecosystems in balance with clever biological weapons like tusks and toxic sprays, then see why the 6,000-plus species of dung beetles are the world's unsung heroes.

programme.title: A Bee's Diary
programme.desc: In a beehive, tens of thousands of tiny animals work toward a common goal: the survival of the colony. But what is life like for an individual honeybee? A Bee's Diary tells that story.

programme.title: Ireland's Wild Islands Season 1

While shoving each other, they accidentally knock over a statue that suddenly emits a light. However, nothing happens that day, and they just shrug it off. The next morning, Fadi and Naura wake up to find their souls swapped. They are completely confused as to why they are trapped in each other's bodies.

programme.title: 唐探1900
Detective Chinatown 1900
programme.desc: 1900年代，美国旧金山唐人街发生白人女子命案，疑凶为一名中国男子此案引发社会公愤，并有人呼吁封闭唐人街唐人街神探孖宝秦与福阿鬼在危机四伏的环境中争分夺秒，誓揭真凶，还原真相

programme.title: 功夫
Kung Fu Hustle

programme.title: 美国女孩
American Girl
programme.desc: 2003年初，移民洛杉矶的芳仪因母亲罹患乳癌，要回到台北迎接新生活面对新学校和疏离多年的父亲，只有13岁的芳仪十分忧虑，亦因此与母亲的关系变差当芳仪的妹妹被误诊感染SARS的时候，一家人被迫隔离，进而解开彼此的心结

programme.title: 西游记之大闹天宫
The Monkey King
programme.desc: 女娲娘娘化成万千五彩晶石补天，其中一颗晶石迸出了孙悟空孙悟空武功高强，不知天高地厚竟挑战玉皇大帝，搞得天宫一片混乱，无意间让牛魔王乘虚而入，欲攻陷天宫重振魔族声威

programme.title: 家有囍事2009
All's Well End's Well 2009
programme.desc: 女强人余珠性格暴躁，一直单身她的弟弟余宝因家中有长女未嫁，弟妹不得嫁娶，否则多灾多难的严格家规，感到十分苦恼为了打破这个困局，余宝聘请了专门解决爱情问题的爱情治疗师曹迪克，向余珠展开热烈追求余珠随即对曹迪克一见钟情，决心让他永远留在自己身边

programme.title: 射鵰英雄传：侠之大者
Legends of the Condor Heroes: The Gallants
programme.desc: 在成吉思汗及其继承者的统领下，蒙古铁骑横扫四方，先灭金朝，后将南宋视为下一目标值此武林各派内部纷争四起之际，郭靖与黄蓉携手团结中原武林英杰，共同守卫襄阳，展现了为国奋战的无畏勇气与坚定忠诚

programme.title: 不日成婚 2
Ready O/R Rot
programme.desc: 阿佳和可怡二人终于要结婚，却遇到佳母施加压力，令二人产生种种摩擦另一边，灰熊又怀疑妻子红杏出墙而当阿健的女友 Jessica意外怀孕时，他陷入人生最迷茫而不知应该如何做决定的时候众人最后可否化解他们感情上的冲突？

programme.title: 赴汤蹈火
Relentless Fury
programme.desc: 暗影小队队长林朗率领雇佣兵团队，接获高危任务，要护送一名神秘女子平安返家她是暗网史上悬赏最高的目标，重赏之下，全球顶尖杀手蠢蠢欲动，恶名昭彰的国际通缉犯Roy亦现身追杀如今，林朗与队友们唯有拼死一搏，才能完成任务

programme.title: 破地狱
The Last Dance
programme.desc: 在疫情肆虐生意萧条的情况下，债台高筑的婚礼策划师道生转型为葬礼经纪人，寻求新的出路凭借创新且独特的经营策略，道生意外获得成功；在德高望重的喃呒师傅文哥的启发下，他的职业观与人生态度随之逐渐蜕变

programme.title: 临时劫案
Rob N Roll
programme.desc: 悍匪梅蓝天策动了闪电械劫，阴差阳错撞上也正在筹划打劫的慕容辉及笠水，于是三人结盟最后这宗临时械劫却惹来警察追捕，并展开一场激烈的追逐战，三人的性命也危在旦夕！

programme.title: 被消失的凶案
A Murder Erased
programme.desc: 警长骆英财被派往调查被埋没八年的尸体发现案随着警长锁定疑犯，一名检控官也参与调查想要找出案件的真相在质问警长之下，检控官更发现他的行为有疑，因他对案件的陈述前后不一，充满疑点...

programme.title: 九龙城寨之围城
Twilight of the Warriors: Walled In
programme.desc: 青年陈洛军因逃难误闯城寨，赫然发现城寨内乱中有序又很包容，从中认定了人生目标，领悟到不少做人的道理他在城寨内结识了一众好兄弟：信一十二少四仔等兄弟们以龙卷风为首，奋力抵抗恶势力大老板的入侵，并展开连番恶斗，誓死保卫城寨这个安身之地

programme.title: Ireland's Wild Islands Season 1
programme.desc: Explore a 1,500-year-old monastery among the dizzying crags of the world-famous Skellig Islands. Spy Manx shearwaters and humpback whales, then chase after pygmy shrews on Clare before heading to the Aran Islands for a peek at an autumn spectacle.

programme.title: Bugs That Rule the World Season 1
programme.desc: Look at what a global insect decline could do to our planet. Uncover our historical dependence on these tiny animals, the vital roles they play in our ecosystems, and the reasons why our fragile relationship to them is in danger worldwide.

programme.title: Bugs That Rule the World Season 1
programme.desc: Learn how bees, butterflies, moths, and other pollinators keep our fields and forests fruitful, and weigh what life would be like if these busy bugs vanished. Witness a mysterious butterfly pilgrimage and a moth's clever way of escaping hungry bats.

programme.title: Bugs That Rule the World Season 1
programme.desc: Go up against predatory insects that are tailor-made for killing. See why the terrifying praying mantis has the agility of a martial artist and an appetite for everything from flies to hummingbirds, then go hunting in mid-air with deadly dragonflies.

programme.title: Bugs That Rule the World Season 1
programme.desc: Get a sanitation lesson from nature's original cleanup crew. Learn how beetles keep ecosystems in balance with clever biological weapons like tusks and toxic sprays, then see why the 6,000-plus species of dung beetles are the world's unsung heroes.

programme.title: A Bee's Diary
programme.desc: In a beehive, tens of thousands of tiny animals work toward a common goal: the survival of the colony. But what is life like for an individual honeybee? A Bee's Diary tells that story.

programme.title: Animal Senses Season 1
programme.desc: The sense of touch is useful to feel physical forces such as bites, changes in temperature and texture. Some animals have become extra sensitive to very faint vibrations, which gives them a lot of information about their environment.

programme.title: My Best Friend's An Animal Season 2
programme.desc: Walk on the wild side with Sirga the lion, whose human pal, Val, has been by her side since she was an orphaned cub. See Loki the raven entertain his BFF Elliott, cuddle with Hugger the stingray, and see why Trish and Garri the koala are like family.

programme.title: My Best Friend's An Animal Season 2
programme.desc: Do rounds on the ranch that Albert the camel runs with his human friend Alex, then check in with Herbie the wallaby as he gets pampered by his pal Fleur. Cause a little chaos with Quincy the quoll and hang ten with Chupacabra the surfing goat.

programme.title: Superbeast Season 1
programme.desc: Prowl the ocean with sharks of all kinds and see why these predatory fish reign supreme under the sea. Stalk coral labyrinths with reef sharks, lie in wait for the perfect strike with wobbegongs, and embark on epic migrations with great whites.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters Season 3
programme.desc: Meet pampered young leopardess Chipadzua, who has never had to hunt for food, thanks to her patient mother. Alone for the first time in her life, will she develop the skills it takes to survive?

programme.title: Africa's Hunters Season 3
programme.desc: Enter the world of a wild dog pack whose bountiful hunting grounds are threatened when a clan of spotted hyenas moves in nearby. The vulnerable pups start to go hungry as the scavenging rivals steal their food and eventually raid their den.

programme.title: Survival of the Beast Season 1
programme.desc: Trek across the Namibian desert with the bush elephant and learn how it keeps its cool in a place with little food or shade. Discover how this giant consumes specific plants, digs wells, and hikes endless dunes in a quest to find precious water.

programme.title: Wild Tales from the Farm Season 1
programme.desc: Watch life on the farm adjust as the leaves start to turn, from the sheep whose woolly coats keep them warm during the first frost to the bees that feed on the last bit of nectar before hibernation.

programme.title: 極限挑戰 第十季
Go Fighting! Season 10 (Repackaged)
programme.desc: 極挑團原班人馬將與新成員一起解鎖更多挑戰，他們將與廣大觀眾一起跨越大江南北，體驗國民生活百態，用真心探訪這片古老土地上正在發生的溫情故事，以更豐富的視角觸摸這卷山河下每一位個體的對美好生活的深切期望

programme.title: 半熟戀人 第4季
Love Actually Season 4 (Repackaged)
programme.desc: 30+的素人嘉賓們帶著成熟與期待，在摩登都市上海入住郊區小屋，從陌生到熟悉，從心動到堅定，共同開啟一段30天的尋愛之旅；除了元老嘉賓謝楠張純燁唐藝昕之外，更邀請了徐藝洋和顏安等組成半熟觀察員，一同見證高甜瞬間

programme.title: 點贊！達人秀
Talent
programme.desc: 全民才藝真人秀節目，圍繞主題聚焦不同類型達人進行同主題表演；邀請了謝霆鋒鄧紫棋孟非伊能靜組成觀察團，從各自的專業知識與觀察視角出發，深入百姓生活，挖掘值得點贊的才藝與故事

programme.title: 遊遍江蘇 第4季
Travel through Jiangsu Season 4
programme.desc: 遊遍江蘇全省的名勝古蹟和大街小巷，尋訪文史學家學者，走訪民間藝人工匠等，探尋風景背後的動人故事，深度觸摸江蘇的文化脈搏，帶領大家發現江蘇的獨特魅力

programme.title: 一拍即合的我們
Hit It Off
programme.desc: 一檔演員搭檔研習進階真人秀，由關錦鵬吳鎮宇許鞍華擔當研習制作人，參與研習階段任務監制和拍攝作品，蘇可擔任研習指導，陳喬恩謝娜李維嘉吳昕作為研習助力團；十多位參與的青年演員，通過共同的生活和訓練，共同開啟尋找搭檔的研習生活

programme.title: 音樂緣計劃
Melody Journey (Repackaged)
programme.desc: 首檔原創音樂創演節目，邀請了薛之謙張靚穎周深單依純黃子弘凡等歌手，同時更邀請小柯方文山黃國倫等樂壇前輩和眾多新生代原創音樂人加盟；由歌曲爭奪戰首演舞台兩大核心環節組成，用一場歌手與歌曲的奇遇，為他們提供一個自由共創的舞台，打造華語樂壇新的高光時刻

programme.title: 與君渡長歡 (短劇)
Eternal Joy With You(Mini drama)
programme.desc: 藥商之女許婉寧前世遭丈夫背叛親生骨肉被害，含恨重生；為了守護孩子並復仇，她與調查禁藥的金鱗衛大督主裴珩結盟，兩人從互有成見的試探，到相知相許的聯手，不僅粉碎了危害朝政的驚天陰謀，更在夢境與現實的交錯中，讓女主重獲自救的勇氣，開啟了全新人生

programme.title: 緣來不晚 第4季
Love Never Comes Late Season 4
programme.desc: 專為資深單身人士定制的相親交友節目，每集有4位男嘉賓和3位女嘉賓，依序進行一對一交流未上場嘉賓則分別在男女嘉賓室觀察場上溝通情況，加深對有意對象的瞭解節目主張為愛回歸，愛情不分年齡，緣來從來不晚

programme.title: 音樂緣計劃 第2季
Crush of Music Season 2 (Repackaged)
programme.desc: 將繼續以音樂牽線，緣分發聲為主題，賽制上進行了全面創新升級，帶來更具懸念的緣分匹配設定更多元的趣味互動模式，以及更動人的團隊默契考驗；匯聚周深薛之謙單依純等10位實力歌手與新銳音樂人，通過盲選歌單即興創作等環碰撞靈感，打造專屬合作舞台！

programme.title: 職來職往2026
Job Match 2026
programme.desc: 打破傳統求職單向選擇的邏輯，從企業滅燈挑錯的評判模式，升級為發掘求職者自身閃光點的賦能模式企業面試官可以隨時爆燈拋出橄欖枝，同步明確崗位與薪酬待遇，大幅拓寬求職者的選擇空間，讓雙向匹配更高效更真誠

programme.title: 非正式會談 第8季
Informal Talks Season 8
programme.desc: 一檔外國人用中文搞事情的文化訪談類節目，由4名主席團成員大左楊迪陳銘及陳超，1名飛行嘉賓與10名不同國家的青年代表聚集在一起，以詼諧態度和調侃精神，增進中國與世界文化的交流，圍繞社會話題及各國風俗文化進行討論

Eternal Joy With You(Mini drama)

programme.desc: Aldo, played by Ridho Illahi, along with his two friends, immediately enters a haunted house arena without paying. Naturally, Qia (Indah Nicole) gets annoyed and scolds the thugs, leading to a war of words. After Qia's friends arrive, the thugs finally leave. Meanwhile, Aldo is suddenly dumped by his girlfriend because she doesn't want him to be a thug anymore. It turns out that the presence of the night market creates a conflict with Aldo's father, who is an actual thug and is determined to ...

programme.title: Naik Ranjang
programme.desc: After being separated for 20 years, Tyas sets out to find her father, Mahdi, to act as her best man at her wedding to Gino. Upon meeting Mahdi, Tyas's fianc, Gino, is taken aback to discover Hani, Tyas's younger sister, who has a child from their past relationship.

programme.title: Cinta Tak Kasat Mata
programme.desc: Vino haunts a beautiful girl he is targeting every day. It is said that Vino was a victim of a romantic conflict that led to his death. Strangely, Vino suddenly appears wearing a dragon club jacket, scaring the girl. However, as the story progresses, Vino continues to help her find safety and security. Until one day, the girl is hospitalized, and her best friend and mother tell her that she has been hallucinating about the existence of Vino, the guy who has been helping her all this time.

programme.title: Di Depan Dukung, Di Belakang Nikung
programme.desc: Riska (Rina Diana), who has run away from home, is hit by a minibus driver named Arya (Vicky Nitinegoro). Upon arriving at Arya's house, Riska looks for an excuse to stay there.

programme.title: Bidadari Surgamu
programme.desc: It tells the story of a girl named Sakinah who lives a life full of pressure due to slander and is forced to marry a person who does not love her. Not only that, Sakinah was even prevented from knowing who her biological mother had the heart to throw her away. How does Sakinah's life story continue?

programme.title: Main Api Jadi Main Hati Bestie
programme.desc: The love story between Tasya (Naomi Zaskia) and Bryan (Arya Vasco) has never been smooth. Tasya is shocked when Bryan reposts a photo with Avril (Allya Syakila). She plans to go to Jakarta to ruin their engagement. Will they end up together, or will they give up on their circumstances?

programme.title: Cinta Dua Pilihan
programme.desc: Fathir and Sukma are a simple yet happily married couple. Their happiness is tested when their child, Zahra, is diagnosed with a serious illness amidst their financial struggles. At the same time, Fathir unexpectedly runs into his ex-girlfriend, Clara, whose presence changes everything.

programme.title: Naura: Suara Dari Mas Kambing
programme.desc: A beautiful girl named Naura (Ina Marika) seems to possess a magical gift where any curse or oath she speaks turns into reality. However, this magical ability suddenly vanishes when Naura falls in love with a goat herder named Satria (Rezca Syam).

programme.title: 出走的决心
Like A Rolling Stone
programme.desc: 中国式好妈妈李红半生任劳任怨，在日复一日的家务与丈夫的冷漠中感到窒息一场高中同学会意外点燃了她被埋没的青春梦想，她决定打破沉重的家庭枷锁，向妻子与母亲的身份辞职李红毅然驾车出走，独自踏上重启人生的漫漫旅程，在广阔天地间寻回那个遗失已久的自我

programme.title: 合家辣
Chilli Laugh Story
programme.desc: 新冠病毒疫情爆发，令Coba在家工作，成天与家人发生争执Coba决定将母亲的手工辣椒酱变成潮物，企图转移家人视线避免争吵Coba的父母和姑妈一起制作手工辣椒酱，并在社交平台上放售，其后辣椒酱大卖，成绩更令大家喜出望外

programme.title: 生死危机
Battle of the Wolf
programme.desc: 前特种部队军官张智勇与妻子在返国航班遇上国际恐怖分子的劫持事件危在旦夕之际，他凭着卓越的军事智慧与英勇无惧的精神，拯救妻子与全体乘客，成功摧毁敌人的恐怖计划，带领众人化险为夷

programme.title: 靠近我一点.
I Believe
programme.desc: 等了初恋男友10年的林楚楚，最终等来的是男友和别人的婚礼正当她对感情失去信心的时候，一位婚礼策划师和一位高富帅男神同时出现在楚楚的生活中，陪她走出了这段黑暗时光面对同样真挚的两个人，楚楚的感情也来到了必须抉择的十字路口，她最后会如何抉择？

programme.title: 临时决斗
Hit N Fun
programme.desc: 澳门拳王钟磊在现实夹缝中苦撑拳馆，坚持培训职业拳手广告总监林雪发现男友外遇对象竟是当红拳击冠军，怒火中烧发出战书，约定擂台一决高下她拜入钟磊门下，投身艰苦训练在汗水与伤痛的洗礼中，林雪逐步蜕变，明白这场战斗，不再为复仇，而是自我重生

programme.title: 大奉打更人之世间无我这般人
No One Like Me
programme.desc: 司天监三弟子杨千幻，曾是世人眼中的天之骄子自许七安横空出世后，他的光芒渐被掩去面对命运的嘲讽与无力，他苦寻出路，却终究敌不过那残酷的真相：天命使然，早已算定即便如此，他仍在沉沦中奋起，以一股不信命的意志逆抗天道

programme.title: 无名指
My First of May
programme.desc: 前壁球冠军邓叔彦与妻子正面临人生的严峻考验，就是女儿罹患罕见脊椎疾病，母亲也同时确诊癌症多年后，当这个家庭在坚持与放弃之间挣扎时，一个微小却充满力量的希望悄然出现 女儿尾指轻轻颤动，让他们重新找回了彼此的连结

programme.title: 峰爆
Cloudy Mountain
programme.desc: 一座修建十年的隧道即将竣工之际，受地震引发连串的地裂和山泥倾泻所影响，隧道与附近的县城危在旦夕一位退休军人和儿子俩，于绝境挺身而出，积极救援为了守护县城16万人的安危，基建的代表人会否炸毁承载了十年心血的隧道呢?

programme.title: 梅兰芳
Forever Enthralled
programme.desc: 电影改编自中国戏曲艺术大师梅兰芳的真人真事，讲述梅兰芳从少时到成名后的遭遇，当中他经历了无数困难和挑战，而其标志性的美国之旅更将传统京剧带到西方直至日本侵华期间，他才断然结束自己多年的职业生涯

programme.title: 叶问：终极一战
Ip Man- The Final Fight
programme.desc: 电影把这位一代宗师叶问晚年在香港的生活如实呈现包括叶问不顾徒弟的反对，在妻子死后与红颜知己歌女的一段缘，与长子叶准之间亦师亦父的父子情，及与晋身成国际武打巨星的徒弟李小龙的重遇等

programme.title: 鬼才之道
Dead Talents Society
programme.desc: 新晋女鬼同学必须在阴间证明自己的生存价值，因为每只鬼魂都必须有吓人业绩才能在鬼界生存无法吓人的鬼不仅拿不到猛鬼证，还可能会消失在阴间过气人气女鬼Catherine和她的经理人Makoto连手，想把同学训练成鬼界新星，让她施展最惊心动魄的吓人技俩

programme.title: 镖人: 风起大漠
Blades of the Guardians
programme.desc: 隋乱将至，逃犯镖客刀马受命护送神秘人，自西域大漠远赴长安不料护送对象竟是天字第一号逃犯，引发各方势力围追堵截，荒漠沙海间厮杀不断随着阴谋逐渐浮出水面，刀马被卷入一场牵动天下的朝廷与江湖博弈，在危机四伏的长安路上，展开一场生死难测的血战

programme.title: 赎梦
Peg O' My Heart
programme.desc: 精神科医生文思豪为夜更的士司机蔡辛强进行治疗蔡辛强深受睡眠的恐惧折磨，已无法分辨梦境与现实随着治疗展开，文医生也逐渐陷入一场令人不安的梦魇之中这场愈演愈烈的恶梦，究竟源于被压抑的记忆，还是揭开蔡辛强秘密所付出的代价？

programme.desc: 由袁成杰余有矿主持，心理咨询师于志凌坐镇的因AI相约，是中国首创全新相亲综艺让AI红娘登场，牵起缘分的红线，用AI独家大数据模型，精准捕捉嘉宾个性，再用AI面具盲选，真诚交流点燃心动瞬间到底是选择AI推荐，还是倾听内心声音？因AI相约用算法助力情缘，让爱情见证最美的邂逅！AI Romance is a dating variety with a spin, marrying scientific AI technology with age-old romance and love! This is Chinas first attempt at artificial intelligence experimental dating series and the programme brings on a whole new viewing experience and refreshed feel, for traditional dating varieties.

programme.title: 两岸一味第一季&第二季
The Flavourful Link Across the Strait S1 & S2
programme.desc: 以街头巷尾的民间味道为联结，追溯两岸美食的中华渊源，讲述两岸故事，共鸣情感与文化六大主题版块，30种两岸吃食，60组人文故事，用两岸一脉共生的食之味，展现两岸一根同源的人情味，讲述两岸饮食的人间烟火，追寻中华民族的味觉乡愁

programme.title: 淮水竹亭
Love in Pavilion

In a time when humans and demons are in conflict, they work together to stabilize the situation to revive the Unity Alliance. programme.title: 灼灼韶华
Wild Ambition Bloom
programme.desc: 1916年，褚韶华为救哥哥而嫁给陈记药铺大少爷陈大顺，她以诚信和出色的商业得到陈父的赏识，成为药铺管理人陈父和陈大顺意外去世后，陈二顺继承药铺并败光家财，药铺陷入绝境褚韶华在艰辛努力下，开了华顺药铺养活一家老小褚韶华后决意携手初恋情人夏初开启新生活，却遭陈二顺和陈母阻挠陈家被土匪洗劫一空，褚韶华也在这次劫难中失去女儿，伤心不已的她独自出走上海褚韶华在上海永新百货业绩突出，受经营奇才闻知秋之邀共同创业，逐步成长为胆略过人重诺守信的女商人This is the story of Chu, who came from a family of traditional Chinese medicine in the early years of China and her life revolving round three men - Xia Chu, Chen Da Shun, and Wen Zhi Qiu. programme.title: 他从火光中走来
Bright Eyes in the Dark
programme.desc: 林陆骁拥有过人的消防技巧和丰富的消防经验，是北浔市特勤一站站长因缘际会下，他被选中成了一档旨在科普消防知识的真人节目的教官在节目中林陆骁偶遇自己多年前从火场中救下的舞蹈演员南初南初对林陆骁充满好感，但林陆骁却因深知自己职业的危险而不愿靠近年轻而勇敢的新一代消防员如邵一九秦十全等崭露头角，从国外带回先进装备技术的楼明冶也回到了消防队老中青三代消防员们在火灾地震空中救援等灾情救援中通力合作，将北浔市的消防安全水平提升了一个台阶南初与林陆骁也在逐渐深入了解中确定了自己的心意，面临最危险的森林火灾，林陆骁与他的队友们依然选择逆火前进

programme.title: 大泼猴
The Legends Of Monkey King
programme.desc: 天道变数，石妖提前三百年破石而出，生存堪忧的石妖踏上了寻仙之路他在求仙路上九死一生，幸得金丝雀舍命相救，石妖因此许下了复活金丝雀的诺言为了实现诺言，石妖一路拜师修行，其间与天真烂漫的风铃和孤傲高冷的杨岚分别暗生情愫，还卷入了众妖与天庭的对抗之中A mortal man accidentally time-travels to the past and becomes the Monkey King. Unwilling to accept his fate, he embarks on a journey that brings him to face gods and demons.

programme.title: 嗨放派 3
Have Fun Season 3
programme.desc: 嗨放派是一档奇趣实验类真人秀综艺节目，第三季主打真实的生存实验，六位艺人嘉宾将开启十天荒岛生存挑战，比如需要自食其力体验搭建帐篷自制淋浴间起火烧饭自制做饭器具等挑战，最后还要举行一场别开生面的海岛运动会，用最好玩的方式将科学实践到生活里头Have Fun returns for a third season! The very well-received China variety again sees six popular male artistes teaming up to escape the constraints and pressures of city life and having fun through exploring interesting scientific topics and real-life Science experiments, this time on a remote island looking for survival!

programme.title: 勇敢无双龙秀晶
The Brave Yong Su Jeong
programme.desc: 该剧为一部浪漫复仇剧，讲述了梦想成为现代版巨商林尚玉的女子龙秀晶与将命运托付给她的吝啬鬼绝症患者吕义柱相遇后，两人共同展开复仇的故事剧中还涉及与财阀家族相关的出生秘密等人物关系Yong Su-Jeong is a popular but shy-in-love host who has a crush on a rich heir, Joo Woo-Jin, while hardworking Yeo Ui-Joos life changes when he discovers hes also part of the same wealthy family.

programme.desc: 林陆骁拥有过人的消防技巧和丰富的消防经验，是北浔市特勤一站站长因缘际会下，他被选中成了一档旨在科普消防知识的真人节目的教官在节目中林陆骁偶遇自己多年前从火场中救下的舞蹈演员南初南初对林陆骁充满好感，但林陆骁却因深知自己职业的危险而不愿靠近年轻而勇敢的新一代消防员如邵一九秦十全等崭露头角，从国外带回先进装备技术的楼明冶也回到了消防队老中青三代消防员们在火灾地震空中救援等灾情救援中通力合作，将北浔市的消防安全水平提升了一个台阶南初与林陆骁也在逐渐深入了解中确定了自己的心意，面临最危险的森林火灾，林陆骁与他的队友们依然选择逆火前进

programme.title: 大泼猴
The Legends Of Monkey King
programme.desc: 天道变数，石妖提前三百年破石而出，生存堪忧的石妖踏上了寻仙之路他在求仙路上九死一生，幸得金丝雀舍命相救，石妖因此许下了复活金丝雀的诺言为了实现诺言，石妖一路拜师修行，其间与天真烂漫的风铃和孤傲高冷的杨岚分别暗生情愫，还卷入了众妖与天庭的对抗之中A mortal man accidentally time-travels to the past and becomes the Monkey King. Unwilling to accept his fate, he embarks on a journey that brings him to face gods and demons.

programme.title: 他从火光中走来
Bright Eyes in the Dark
programme.desc: 林陆骁拥有过人的消防技巧和丰富的消防经验，是北浔市特勤一站站长因缘际会下，他被选中成了一档旨在科普消防知识的真人节目的教官在节目中林陆骁偶遇自己多年前从火场中救下的舞蹈演员南初南初对林陆骁充满好感，但林陆骁却因深知自己职业的危险而不愿靠近年轻而勇敢的新一代消防员如邵一九秦十全等崭露头角，从国外带回先进装备技术的楼明冶也回到了消防队老中青三代消防员们在火灾地震空中救援等灾情救援中通力合作，将北浔市的消防安全水平提升了一个台阶南初与林陆骁也在逐渐深入了解中确定了自己的心意，面临最危险的森林火灾，林陆骁与他的队友们依然选择逆火前进

programme.title: 灼灼韶华

programme.title: 这就是街舞 6
Street Dance of China 6
programme.desc: 这！就是街舞再次强势回归，第六季节目迎来了常驻舞蹈导师的全新组合，包括Jay ParkVanness 吴建豪丁程鑫，都是非常优秀的舞者以及队长在全新一季这！就是街舞中，将会有哪些街舞大神为大家带来热血炸裂的舞台？内容上不断带来惊喜外，让我们共同期待街舞引燃2023！

programme.title: 祈今朝
Sword and Fairy
programme.desc: 越今朝和越祈二人在乌岩村相伴三年，有着神奇的共鸣关系，却对各自的身世一无所知二人携手闯荡江湖，希望找回过往记忆双越二人被卷入启魂圣宗作乱和洛家堡血祭等神秘事件之中，而在对抗圣宗过程中意外让越祈被封印的回忆和情感被开启随着事件发展，双越结识了洛家堡双子洛埋名和洛昭言千年狼妖闲卿顾寒江和明绣师徒以及居十方等江湖人士，二人的真实身份也逐渐揭开

programme.title: Wild Tales from the Farm Season 1
programme.desc: Winter is coming, and the animals take advantage of autumn's final bounty before the cold, barren months ahead. Watch some creatures search for respite indoors, while others arrive from far northern climates to settle in the ploughed fields.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters Season 3
programme.desc: Meet pampered young leopardess Chipadzua, who has never had to hunt for food, thanks to her patient mother. Alone for the first time in her life, will she develop the skills it takes to survive?

programme.title: Africa's Hunters Season 3
programme.desc: Enter the world of a wild dog pack whose bountiful hunting grounds are threatened when a clan of spotted hyenas moves in nearby. The vulnerable pups start to go hungry as the scavenging rivals steal their food and eventually raid their den.

programme.title: Bugs That Rule the World Season 1
programme.desc: Learn how bees, butterflies, moths, and other pollinators keep our fields and forests fruitful, and weigh what life would be like if these busy bugs vanished. Witness a mysterious butterfly pilgrimage and a moth's clever way of escaping hungry bats.

programme.title: Coral City Season 1
programme.desc: Discover the most fantastic city of them all lying beneath the waves, where romance and migratory commuters flood the coral reef's main highways. Follow a green sea turtle looking for love and sit in with a cassowary dad tending his newborn chicks.

programme.title: Coral City Season 1

programme.desc: 徐冬熙梦想成为服装设计师，一场突如其来的意外，却让她必须领养侄子成为了单亲妈妈，多亏家人及邻居协助，让她在照顾侄子之余仍得以重拾曾经放弃的梦想姜次烈则年幼时父亲去世，其后被叔叔收养，虽曾有彷徨时期，但他头脑聪明成绩和外貌出众，可是他做的越好，哥哥和妈妈的表情就越冷淡为了迎合母亲的喜好，次烈无法凭自己的意愿生活，虽然不想继承家族企业却被安排进入公司工作，虽不开心但也只能等着离开这个家独立的日子Seo Dong-Hee comes from a poor family background but despite this, she has a bright and positive personality. She dreams of becoming a designer and slowly works her way to achieve her dream. A family accident resulted in her becoming the mother of her nephew and she decides to raise him by h...

programme.title: 大泼猴
The Legends Of Monkey King
programme.desc: 天道变数，石妖提前三百年破石而出，生存堪忧的石妖踏上了寻仙之路他在求仙路上九死一生，幸得金丝雀舍命相救，石妖因此许下了复活金丝雀的诺言为了实现诺言，石妖一路拜师修行，其间与天真烂漫的风铃和孤傲高冷的杨岚分别暗生情愫，还卷入了众妖与天庭的对抗之中A mortal man accidentally time-travels to the past and becomes the Monkey King. Unwilling to accept his fate, he embarks on a journey that brings him to face gods and demons.

programme.title: 他从火光中走来

programme.desc: 林陆骁拥有过人的消防技巧和丰富的消防经验，是北浔市特勤一站站长因缘际会下，他被选中成了一档旨在科普消防知识的真人节目的教官在节目中林陆骁偶遇自己多年前从火场中救下的舞蹈演员南初南初对林陆骁充满好感，但林陆骁却因深知自己职业的危险而不愿靠近年轻而勇敢的新一代消防员如邵一九秦十全等崭露头角，从国外带回先进装备技术的楼明冶也回到了消防队老中青三代消防员们在火灾地震空中救援等灾情救援中通力合作，将北浔市的消防安全水平提升了一个台阶南初与林陆骁也在逐渐深入了解中确定了自己的心意，面临最危险的森林火灾，林陆骁与他的队友们依然选择逆火前进

programme.title: 心动的信号 6

programme.desc: 1916年，褚韶华为救哥哥而嫁给陈记药铺大少爷陈大顺，她以诚信和出色的商业得到陈父的赏识，成为药铺管理人陈父和陈大顺意外去世后，陈二顺继承药铺并败光家财，药铺陷入绝境褚韶华在艰辛努力下，开了华顺药铺养活一家老小褚韶华后决意携手初恋情人夏初开启新生活，却遭陈二顺和陈母阻挠陈家被土匪洗劫一空，褚韶华也在这次劫难中失去女儿，伤心不已的她独自出走上海褚韶华在上海永新百货业绩突出，受经营奇才闻知秋之邀共同创业，逐步成长为胆略过人重诺守信的女商人This is the story of Chu, who came from a family of traditional Chinese medicine in the early years of China and her life revolving round three men - Xia Chu, Chen Da Shun, and Wen Zhi Qiu. programme.title: 祈今朝
Sword and Fairy
programme.desc: 越今朝和越祈二人在乌岩村相伴三年，有着神奇的共鸣关系，却对各自的身世一无所知二人携手闯荡江湖，希望找回过往记忆双越二人被卷入启魂圣宗作乱和洛家堡血祭等神秘事件之中，而在对抗圣宗过程中意外让越祈被封印的回忆和情感被开启随着事件发展，双越结识了洛家堡双子洛埋名和洛昭言千年狼妖闲卿顾寒江和明绣师徒以及居十方等江湖人士，二人的真实身份也逐渐揭开

programme.title: 他从火光中走来
Bright Eyes in the Dark
programme.desc: 林陆骁拥有过人的消防技巧和丰富的消防经验，是北浔市特勤一站站长因缘际会下，他被选中成了一档旨在科普消防知识的真人节目的教官在节目中林陆骁偶遇自己多年前从火场中救下的舞蹈演员南初南初对林陆骁充满好感，但林陆骁却因深知自己职业的危险而不愿靠近年轻而勇敢的新一代消防员如邵一九秦十全等崭露头角，从国外带回先进装备技术的楼明冶也回到了消防队老中青三代消防员们在火灾地震空中救援等灾情救援中通力合作，将北浔市的消防安全水平提升了一个台阶南初与林陆骁也在逐渐深入了解中确定了自己的心意，面临最危险的森林火灾，林陆骁与他的队友们依然选择逆火前进

programme.title: 灼灼韶华
Wild Ambition Bloom
programme.desc: 1916年，褚韶华为救哥哥而嫁给陈记药铺大少爷陈大顺，她以诚信和出色的商业得到陈父的赏识，成为药铺管理人陈父和陈大顺意外去世后，陈二顺继承药铺并败光家财，药铺陷入绝境褚韶华在艰辛努力下，开了华顺药铺养活一家老小褚韶华后决意携手初恋情人夏初开启新生活，却遭陈二顺和陈母阻挠陈家被土匪洗劫一空，褚韶华也在这次劫难中失去女儿，伤心不已的她独自出走上海褚韶华在上海永新百货业绩突出，受经营奇才闻知秋之邀共同创业，逐步成长为胆略过人重诺守信的女商人This is the story of Chu, who came from a family of traditional Chinese medicine in the early years of China and her life revolving round three men - Xia Chu, Chen Da Shun, and Wen Zhi Qiu. Not succumbing to the unfair arrangements of the times and fate, Chu gradually ex...

programme.title: 型男大主厨
Stylish Man
programme.desc: 台湾广受欢迎的常青美食料理节目，由2006年始播至今，2011年还获选金钟奖的最佳综合节目主持人奖每一期将有不同的主题：大明星來下廚由兩位明星或两个明星档分組對抗，拿出自己的拿手菜對抗比拼；五分钟出好菜由两位厨师根据指定食材，在五分钟内烹煮出易学美味的一道菜等这是一个富有娱乐效果的轻松美食节目，能够持续制作这么多年不是没有理由的

programme.title: 乡野有真味第三季
Country Roads Delicious Food S3
programme.desc: 乡野有真味第三季将镜头投向中国南方的隐秘角落广东广西浙江福建湖南江西安徽贵州八省，深入竹林溪涧古村深巷，探访那些颠覆味蕾认知的暗黑美食与新奇风味，揭开乡土食材与地域文化交织的味觉密码Country Roads Delicious Food S3 turns to the hidden corners of southern China, the eight provinces of Guangdong, Guangxi, Zhejiang, Fujian, Hunan, Jiangxi, Anhui and Guizhou. programme.title: 两岸一味第一季&第二季
The Flavourful Link Across the Strait S1 & S2
programme.desc: 以街头巷尾的民间味道为联结，追溯两岸美食的中华渊源，讲述两岸故事，共鸣情感与文化六大主题版块，30种两岸吃食，60组人文故事，用两岸一脉共生的食之味，展现两岸一根同源的人情味，讲述两岸饮食的人间烟火，追寻中华民族的味觉乡愁

programme.desc: 1916年，褚韶华为救哥哥而嫁给陈记药铺大少爷陈大顺，她以诚信和出色的商业得到陈父的赏识，成为药铺管理人陈父和陈大顺意外去世后，陈二顺继承药铺并败光家财，药铺陷入绝境褚韶华在艰辛努力下，开了华顺药铺养活一家老小褚韶华后决意携手初恋情人夏初开启新生活，却遭陈二顺和陈母阻挠陈家被土匪洗劫一空，褚韶华也在这次劫难中失去女儿，伤心不已的她独自出走上海褚韶华在上海永新百货业绩突出，受经营奇才闻知秋之邀共同创业，逐步成长为胆略过人重诺守信的女商人This is the story of Chu, who came from a family of traditional Chinese medicine in the early years of China and her life revolving round three men - Xia Chu, Chen Da Shun, and Wen Zhi Qiu. programme.title: 祈今朝
Sword and Fairy
programme.desc: 越今朝和越祈二人在乌岩村相伴三年，有着神奇的共鸣关系，却对各自的身世一无所知二人携手闯荡江湖，希望找回过往记忆双越二人被卷入启魂圣宗作乱和洛家堡血祭等神秘事件之中，而在对抗圣宗过程中意外让越祈被封印的回忆和情感被开启随着事件发展，双越结识了洛家堡双子洛埋名和洛昭言千年狼妖闲卿顾寒江和明绣师徒以及居十方等江湖人士，二人的真实身份也逐渐揭开

programme.title: Shadowlands Season 1
programme.desc: Learn how winter's arrival triggers animal survival instincts in southwestern New Zealand. Track dolphins as they move to warmer waters to give their calves a fighting chance, and join longfin eels on an epic migration to their spawning grounds.

programme.title: America's Wild Seasons Season 1
programme.desc: As fall sweeps across America and trees are set ablaze with color, animals are faced with make-or-break decisions. Find out how bald eagles, beavers, and other creatures prepare for the colder, darker, and leaner months ahead.

Since then, there is no news of his proposal and Qiu Rong confronts Liang Cai when she finds herself pregnant. This is when she discovers that he has already married a rich noble girl and even plans to kill her

programme.desc: The aggressive and dangerous Chin Empire conquers the hard-put Chao kingdom while the Wei empire is drained of its heroes and paralyzed by an indecisive ruler. Adventure, intrigue, death and tragedy reigns before the triumphant clash of the armies.
